policy.age_basis: later publication and first followed Git source date; existing live members, or all existing members if fully retired
policy.family_keep_rule: clicks >= 3 OR distinct family engaged visitor-days >= 2
policy.safeguards: Verified complete family identity and evidence coverage required; unknown evidence blocks changes. Youth or concrete actual use protects the complete family.

engagement_window.limitations: Collection began 2026-09-22 part day; route attribution introduced 2026-09-23 part day. Pre-baseline missing paths are archived limitations. Page-read signal introduced 2026-10-19 about 21:00 UTC; older single-page reading cannot be reconstructed. Cohorts remain separate; visitor-days are not unique people.

measurement.search: Page-level WEB Search Console URL exports, including anonymized queries, across verified old/current domains and URL aliases; family clicks and impressions are summed after identity reconciliation. Export-confirmed empty days are observed coverage, not missing days.
measurement.engagement: Current app admin builders qualify visitor-days across the whole website before blog attribution: a page view and at least two qualifying facts total on the same UTC day, including the page view, with trust, bot, admin, test, manual, automation, sandbox, burst and scraper-fleet exclusions. Identified days use resolved actors and occurred_at; cookieless days use daily hashes and server_received_at. Family visitor-days deduplicate cohort, resolved visitor and UTC date across member URLs; per-URL visitor-days must not be summed.
measurement.attribution: Collector page_path is locale-stripped; ui_locale restores localized identity before verified alias matching. Attributable positives anywhere in the nominal interval, including pre-baseline and current partial-day activity, count. Negative coverage uses the disclosed reliable interval through yesterday; no earlier missing attribution is treated as zero.
measurement.age: The later declared publication date and first followed Git source appearance is an availability proxy, not proof of deployment. Baseline source hashes and revisions describe sources before restoration; historical ledgers remain unchanged.

provenance.attribution_baseline_basis: PR367 production READY 2026-09-23T09:58:38.760Z, matching actual page-path producer source; first fully observed attributed UTC day 2026-09-24. No filtered page-view missing paths since.
provenance.new_domain_empty_basis: Successful URL ExportLog entries on both days, no URL partition/rows; production cutover READY 2026-09-18T08:43:00.505Z. All Sep18+ new-domain active dates exported with partitions.
provenance.source_parity: The production cutover site.ts and route-attribution producer/collector match their verified source blobs. Frozen app main supplies the current metric contract; the deployed admin revision is recorded separately.
provenance.unmapped_search_diagnostics: Five spellings have no source in frozen corpus or followed/all Git path history and zero clicks. They remain separate diagnostics; no positive-click ambiguity affects an existing family.
provenance.restoration_gate: 20261022T102141068545Z: refreshed family decisions have no classification flips; 151 restoration sources remain after the preceding slice. Measurement baseline remains the frozen website revision.

preservation: Publication changes remove retirement-only frontmatter and preserve all other metadata. Article bodies are preserved except for the scoped contextual repairs to currently retired destinations; useful conceptual prose and currently published references are retained.
